consumer: The engine's u_has_items dialogue/condition predicate (conditional_t::set_has_items) asking 'does the alpha character currently possess 1st_aid?' as a computed yes/no that a mission/dialogue/eligibility check consumes.
scope: only the character's own carried items (on-person: wielded, worn, and inventory, recursing into worn containers) — NOT items reachable on nearby tiles or containers.
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_items — its body returns actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count) over the character actor, the engine-computed possession predicate for the item.
divergence: A 1st_aid lying on the ground at the player's feet (or in an adjacent container) but not on the player: the on-person possession predicate returns false, while a wrong answer that re-derives from a too-broad reachable/nearby scan returns true.
